    • getTechnicalQualificationCalculations

      public List<EngineeringCalculation> getTechnicalQualificationCalculations(String subjectNodeId)
      Adapts the typed technical qualification results to canonical calculation records.

      This keeps the calculation DAG, engineering graph, and production-readiness evidence on the same identifiers without weakening the typed calculation API.

      Parameters:
      subjectNodeId - canonical project node governed by the qualification results
      Returns:
      canonical calculation records in stable discipline order
